svg.title: Base-Case Operator Revenue to Owner Profit
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-profit-bridge; chart type: waterfall; title: Base-Case Operator Revenue to Owner Profit; subtitle: $362,500 recognized operator revenue less $224,750 operating costs.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD annually. Opening and closing bars are totals; the four intermediate bars are signed cost changes. Canonical gross revenue means operator revenue, not customer transaction value. Revenue includes $210,000 SaaS, $12,500 permitted builder compensation, $90,000 CPA, and $50,000 settled NGR commissions. The illustrative cost allocation reconciles exactly to Formula v2.0.; caption: $362,500 - $85,000 - $90,000 - $24,000 - $25,750 = $137,750; $137,750 / $362,500 = 38.0%. Affiliate contractual deductions are already reflected in recognized commission revenue.; stages: label: Recognized operator revenue; value: $362,500 annual opening total; numeric value: 362500.0; detail: Book subscriptions and earned software compensation separately from affiliate commissions. The $50,000 NGR allocation equals $80,000 preliminary contractual commission less $18,000 allocated admin and bonus deductions and $12,000 negative carryover. Apply ASC 606 principal-versus-agent analysis; no additional retained-share multiplier is supplied for this scorecard.; label: Acquisition and distribution; value: -$85,000 annual operating cost; numeric value: -85000.0; detail: Allocate $45,000 to SaaS acquisition, $30,000 to CPA acquisition, and $10,000 to NGR acquisition. The CPA cohort therefore carries $300 acquisition cost per payable depositor. Measure channel contribution after partner adjustments, not against headline commission offers.; label: Contractor delivery capacity; value: -$90,000 annual operating cost; numeric value: -90000.0; detail: Budget $54,000 for the engineering contractor and $36,000 for the acquisition and editorial contractor. The founder is the one full-time seat and receives the residual owner-profit measure; no separate founder salary is assumed in this illustrative allocation.; label: Platform and billing infrastructure; value: -$24,000 annual operating cost; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Fund permitted feed access, managed PostgreSQL, cloud delivery, monitoring, subscription billing fees, and attribution infrastructure. Track stale-feed incidents and webhook replay failures as service costs; user trading fees belong in comparison analytics rather than operator revenue.; label: Professional and operating overhead; value: -$25,750 annual operating cost; numeric value: -25750.0; detail: Allocate $12,000 to activity classification and state vendor work, $6,000 to accounting and insurance, $4,750 to support and administrative tools, and $3,000 to refunds and collection losses. Refunds are charged here only when not already netted from opening revenue.; label: Owner profit; value: $137,750 annual closing total; 38.0%; numeric value: 137750.0; detail: Operating costs total $224,750, leaving the canonical Base-Case owner profit of $137,750. Fixed delivery, platform, and overhead costs average $11,645.83 monthly before acquisition; this exceeds the metadata's $10,000 monthly upper bound, so that range cannot represent all-in Base-Case costs.

rect.title: label: Recognized operator revenue; value: $362,500 annual opening total; numeric value: 362500.0; detail: Book subscriptions and earned software compensation separately from affiliate commissions. The $50,000 NGR allocation equals $80,000 preliminary contractual commission less $18,000 allocated admin and bonus deductions and $12,000 negative carryover. Apply ASC 606 principal-versus-agent analysis; no additional retained-share multiplier is supplied for this scorecard.

label: Acquisition and distribution; value: -$85,000 annual operating cost; numeric value: -85000.0; detail: Allocate $45,000 to SaaS acquisition, $30,000 to CPA acquisition, and $10,000 to NGR acquisition. The CPA cohort therefore carries $300 acquisition cost per payable depositor. Measure channel contribution after partner adjustments, not against headline commission offers.

label: Contractor delivery capacity; value: -$90,000 annual operating cost; numeric value: -90000.0; detail: Budget $54,000 for the engineering contractor and $36,000 for the acquisition and editorial contractor. The founder is the one full-time seat and receives the residual owner-profit measure; no separate founder salary is assumed in this illustrative allocation.

label: Platform and billing infrastructure; value: -$24,000 annual operating cost; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Fund permitted feed access, managed PostgreSQL, cloud delivery, monitoring, subscription billing fees, and attribution infrastructure. Track stale-feed incidents and webhook replay failures as service costs; user trading fees belong in comparison analytics rather than operator revenue.

label: Professional and operating overhead; value: -$25,750 annual operating cost; numeric value: -25750.0; detail: Allocate $12,000 to activity classification and state vendor work, $6,000 to accounting and insurance, $4,750 to support and administrative tools, and $3,000 to refunds and collection losses. Refunds are charged here only when not already netted from opening revenue.

label: Owner profit; value: $137,750 annual closing total; 38.0%; numeric value: 137750.0; detail: Operating costs total $224,750, leaving the canonical Base-Case owner profit of $137,750. Fixed delivery, platform, and overhead costs average $11,645.83 monthly before acquisition; this exceeds the metadata's $10,000 monthly upper bound, so that range cannot represent all-in Base-Case costs.

Revenue includes $210,000 SaaS, $12,500 permitted builder compensation, $90,000 CPA, and $50,000 settled NGR commissions. The illustrative cost allocation reconciles exactly to Formula v2.0.
